metadata.title: Mutations in the diastrophic dysplasia sulfate transporter (DTDST) gene: correlation between sulfate transport activity and chondrodysplasia phenotype

entities.name: DTDST
entities.description: Encodes a transmembrane sulfate transporter; mutations are responsible for recessively inherited chondrodysplasias.

entities.name: chondrodysplasias
entities.description: Group of recessively inherited skeletal disorders associated with DTDST mutations.

entities.name: sulfate transport deficiency
entities.description: Reduced sulfate transport associated with DTDST mutations and under-sulfation of proteoglycans.

entities.name: under-sulfation of proteoglycans
entities.description: Proteoglycan under-sulfation resulting from reduced sulfate transport in chondrocytes.

relations.mechanism: Mutations in DTDST reduce sulfate transport into chondrocytes.
relations.evidence: The DTDST gene encodes a sulfate transporter that also accepts chloride and possibly bicarbonate as substrates... Reduced sulfate transport in chondrocytes of individuals with DTDST mutations results in the under-sulfation of proteoglycans.

relations.mechanism: Reduced sulfate transport in chondrocytes results in under-sulfation of proteoglycans.
relations.evidence: Reduced sulfate transport in chondrocytes of individuals with DTDST mutations results in the under-sulfation of proteoglycans, which in turn leads to abnormal cartilage formation.

relations.mechanism: Mutations in DTDST are responsible for four recessively inherited chondrodysplasias.
relations.evidence: Mutations in this gene are responsible for four recessively inherited chondrodysplasias that include diastrophic dysplasia, multiple epiphyseal dysplasia, atelosteogenesis type 2 and achondrogenesis 1B (ACG-1B).
